hospitals.note: Private tertiary hospital.

hospitals.note: Private tertiary hospital.

hospitals.name: B&B Hospital

hospitals.name: Om Hospital and Research Centre
hospitals.note: Private hospital with neurosciences.

hospitals.name: B.P. Koirala Institute of Health Sciences (BPKIHS)
hospitals.note: The principal tertiary referral centre for eastern Nepal. Avoids travel to Kathmandu for much of the east.

hospitals.name: Manipal Teaching Hospital
